problem_statement: Rebinding a UDP (datagram) socket fails. When a datagram socket has already been bound (so its connection is already registered to an interface and port), a second call to bind() on the same socket returns an error (EISCONN) instead of re-binding the socket to the new address/port. As a result, a program that binds a UDP socket, then re-binds it to a different local port and continues exchanging datagrams cannot succeed. Rebinding should succeed for datagram sockets; only stream sockets should still reject rebinding.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/socket/udp -s tests/net/socket/udp/net.socket.udp -s net.socket.udp -O twister-out --no-clean -W
